definitions.edge_vs_hold_rlusd: paper portfolio value minus the untouched start balances valued at the same price
definitions.realized_edge_rlusd: closed grid cycles: XRP profit x current price + RLUSD profit
definitions.unrealized_edge_rlusd: edge vs hold minus realized (open grid inventory marked at the current price, net of fees)
definitions.price_effect_rlusd: change in the hold baseline's value since start (price movement only)
